purpose: Continue the minimum-service-unit scan, aggressively close generic routes already served by incumbents, and retain only a narrow Xuzhou emergency-hydraulic-hose routing residual for further public research.

closures.title: Small-batch heat-treatment / anodizing / plating routing
closures.observed_pressure: Small batches can be harmed by minimum batch charges and external-process coordination.
counterevidence: Current machining/finishing providers publicly support 1-piece prototypes and small-batch surface treatment.
Integrated CNC + finishing providers already bundle quoting, process selection, finishing and delivery.
Public pricing guidance explicitly recognizes minimum charges, but this alone does not prove a routing gap.
closures.reopen_only_if: A named Xuzhou/Jiangsu buyer is repeatedly forced to pay a minimum batch/furnace charge or delay because current small-batch finishing providers cannot accept the exact material/process/acceptance combination.

closures.title: Small-lot CNC cutting-tool regrinding routing
closures.observed_pressure: Worn carbide tools are recurring assets; factories want lower replacement cost and regrinders want recurring workload.
counterevidence: OSG China already offers regrinding, including third-party tool products, with local sales contact and return delivery.
刀聚云 already describes order digitization and C2M workflow for the tooling industry.
智刀云 already aggregates a large cutting-tool procurement/manufacturing ecosystem.
closures.reopen_only_if: A named local factory has a recurring class of tools that existing OEM/regrind channels reject or process too slowly, with measurable tool-cost or downtime impact.

closures.title: Discontinued PLC / industrial automation spare-part sourcing
closures.observed_pressure: A missing obsolete controller or module can hold an old production asset offline.
counterevidence: Multiple current suppliers explicitly specialize in obsolete and hard-to-find PLC/DCS/HMI/drive parts.
Existing services already perform global sourcing, model verification, substitute-part analysis, used/refurbished sourcing and door-to-door delivery.
closures.reopen_only_if: A named local asset owner has a specific obsolete part that mature global sourcing networks cannot locate or safely substitute, and the unresolved outage cost is measurable.

closures.title: No-drawing old-part reverse engineering and replication
closures.observed_pressure: Legacy parts can fail after drawings and original suppliers disappear.
counterevidence: Current reverse-engineering providers explicitly sell 3D scanning, CAD reconstruction and old-part replication.
Some providers combine scanning, reverse engineering and direct manufacturing / 3D printing / machining.
Small-lot sourcing providers already advertise one-piece reverse-engineered replacement parts.
closures.reopen_only_if: A named local machine owner has a specific failed part for which existing reverse-engineering providers cannot meet the time-to-value, material, tolerance or acceptance requirement.

retained_candidate.title: Xuzhou emergency hydraulic-hose restoration routing
reality_change: Xuzhou remains a dense engineering-machinery and hydraulic-supply cluster.
Hydraulic hose failure is a stop-work event for many mobile and industrial machines.
Mobile hose workshops prove that one-site hose fabrication/replacement can be delivered as a narrow emergency task rather than a full maintenance contract.

actor_a.type: construction-machinery owner / rental operator / industrial asset operator with a failed hydraulic hose
actor_a.named_reachable_example: 徐州众瑞达工程机械有限公司
actor_a.evidence_boundary: Public evidence proves a reachable local operator with a fleet, not that this actor has a recent hose-failure event.

actor_b.type: local hydraulic-hose fabricator / hose shop / hydraulic service node
named_reachable_examples: 徐州永达液压设备有限公司
徐州苏强格液压有限公司
local high-pressure-hose shops visible in Xuzhou business listings
actor_b.observed_capability: hose assemblies, fittings, crimping/manufacturing and local hydraulic service capability exist in Xuzhou
actor_b.supply_hunger_evidence: 徐州永达 currently recruits sales capacity to find leads and customers; this is only weak-to-moderate hunger evidence, not proof of spare emergency-response capacity.

evidence: OEM/service guidance explicitly treats hose failure as a source of equipment downtime.
Hydraulic-hose vendors describe leakage/burst events as causing stop-work and delayed schedules.
Emergency mobile hose service exists internationally precisely to reduce unplanned downtime.

supply_hunger.reason: Local hose/repair supply is abundant and at least one local hose firm is actively recruiting sales, but willingness to take small urgent mobile jobs is not yet publicly established.

evidence: Xuzhou has multiple hose, hydraulic-component and engineering-machinery repair businesses.
徐州苏强格 publicly reports a local hose-assembly production base with large annual capacity.
中华为业 in Xuzhou sells hose assemblies, fittings and fluid-connection systems.

retained_candidate.observed_connection_pressure: When a hose fails, the machine needs one correctly specified hose assembly immediately; current public local evidence is dominated by factory supply, stores, OEM service and general repair rather than a clearly visible citywide mobile-hose dispatch layer.
current_workaround_hypothesis: remove old hose and transport it to a hose shop for matching/crimping
wait for a part or service technician
use temporary low-pressure operation only when safe
retained_candidate.workaround_truth_status: NOT YET BOUND TO ONE RECENT XUZHOU EVENT
existing_market_service: HANSA-FLEX sells mobile hydraulic service and reports only three mobile service vehicles in China in its public China profile.
Hydroscand China advertises mobile hose field service and a Nanjing-area phone route.
XCMG and other OEMs operate broad service and spare-parts networks.
Local Xuzhou hose makers and shops supply assemblies and fittings.
why_existing_route_may_be_incomplete: Public China mobile-hose networks exist, so the service concept itself is not novel.
The unresolved question is geographic/service-density coverage in Xuzhou for non-OEM or out-of-warranty machines and mixed brands.

Public Xuzhou results do not yet show a mature neutral dispatch network that identifies the hose/fitting, finds the nearest available crimp capability, sends fabrication/installation to the machine and closes acceptance.
retained_candidate.missing_edge: POSSIBLE: last-mile emergency orchestration from failed machine -> hose identification -> available compatible hose/fitting/crimp node -> field delivery/install -> pressure/leak acceptance.
retained_candidate.minimum_service_unit: restore one failed hydraulic hose circuit on one machine

rooter_execution_map.partial_flow: operators already call OEMs, repair shops and hose suppliers; mobile hose service is proven elsewhere
rooter_execution_map.missing_edge: neutral local availability + specification + dispatch + evidence + acceptance layer may be missing
rooter_execution_map.task_definition: machine/location + hose/fitting/photo/old-hose evidence + pressure/application + access constraints
rooter_execution_map.executor: qualified hose fabrication / field-service provider, not Rooter
rooter_execution_map.acceptance: correct hose/fittings installed, no leakage at controlled test pressure, machine function restored, evidence recorded
rooter_execution_map.payer: machine owner / rental operator / responsible maintenance party
rooter_execution_map.value_capture: emergency convenience/coordination spread plus optional dispatch/service fee
rooter_execution_map.operator_role: intake schema, compatibility routing, availability check, dispatch, evidence, acceptance, settlement, provider history
rooter_execution_map.operator_non_role: do not personally crimp hoses, diagnose unsafe hydraulic systems, or perform recurring field labor
rooter_execution_map.bypass_risk: HIGH for repeated buyer-provider pairs; defensibility would require multi-provider availability, response-time reliability, compatibility history and emergency routing rather than simple introduction
rooter_execution_map.operator_exit: possible if intake, compatibility, provider availability, dispatch and acceptance can be delegated/systemized

reachability.named_actor: 徐州众瑞达工程机械有限公司
reachability.physical_access_route: local Xuzhou operator; exact visit address available from public company materials/search
reachability.decision_maker_distance: likely owner/manager-level public business phone, but not yet verified
reachability.caveat: Reachability A does not promote the candidate because recent-event and current-workaround truth are still unbound.

mobilization.hard_gate_reason: No named recent Xuzhou hose-failure event, no measured current workaround time/cost, and no proof that local supply wants/has capacity for urgent mobile jobs.

cheapest_decisive_reality_probe.reason: Public research has narrowed the question, but Mobilization is not HIGH under the evidence gate.
cheapest_decisive_reality_probe.future_question_if_released: Ask one fleet/repair operator only about the most recent hydraulic-hose failure: when, what machine, how they got the replacement made, who they called, whether the hose was removed and transported, total wait/downtime, total cost, and why OEM/mobile service was or was not used.

kill_conditions: Xuzhou operators already have dependable 24/7 OEM/dealer/mobile-hose response at acceptable time and price.
Local hose shops commonly provide rapid on-site fabrication/installation directly, making routing redundant.
Most failures require broader hydraulic diagnosis/repair rather than a bounded hose-restoration unit.
Compatibility/safety information cannot be standardized enough for safe routing.
Repeat buyers simply call the same hose shop after first use and orchestration adds no recurring value.
promotion_conditions: One named Xuzhou operator provides a recent real hose-failure event with measurable downtime/cost and a fragmented workaround.
At least two independent local hose/service nodes confirm they can accept the same bounded emergency task and disclose service radius/availability.
The operator can define a safe minimum intake/acceptance schema without performing hydraulic diagnosis.
The route beats the current workaround on time-to-restoration without requiring inventory ownership.
A repeatable inbound demand pump exists around urgent search/maintenance channels rather than founder-by-founder enterprise sales.

current_best_next_truth: Continue public research specifically on Xuzhou emergency hydraulic-hose restoration: bind one recent local failure/workaround and determine whether local hose nodes already provide fast mobile fabrication/installation. Kill immediately if dependable local mobile service is already routine.
